panels.title: ◈ Machine PE Capability - Cp vs Cpk

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS stddev_pe, AVG(pe_setting) AS pe_limit
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, mean_pe, stddev_pe, pe_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0) AS cp,
    LEAST((pe_limit - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0), (mean_pe + pe_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) AS cpk
  FROM stats
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(cp::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cp", ROUND(cpk::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk"
FROM capability ORDER BY cpk DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.description: Calculated from real PE1-PE6 samples in the selected time, Factory, MO and Machine filters. Assumes symmetric +/- pe_setting limits.

panels.title: ◈ PE Standard Deviation by Machine (Lower is Better)

targets.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(pe)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "StdDev"
FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(pe) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "StdDev" DESC;

panels.description: Real PE1-PE6 standard deviation for the selected filters. Replaces the missing v_process_stability view.

panels.title: ◉ Alarm ↔ Process Correlation (RCA Truth Test)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'THERMAL (81501)' AS "Alarm Category", ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_temp_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS "Correlation %", COUNT(*) AS "Event Count" FROM v_ldi_alarm_context WHERE errorcode = '81501'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'VACUUM (81101/02)', ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_vac_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1), COUNT(*) FROM v_ldi_alarm_context WHERE errorcode IN ('81101','81102')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ALIGNMENT (812xx)', ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE flag_pe_out_of_spec) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1), COUNT(*) FROM v_ldi_alarm_context WHERE errorcode IN ('81201','81203','81204')

panels.description: Correlation between Alarm occurrences and actual Process anomalies out of spec (RCA Validation)
